question: In 1893, Swami Vivekananda participated in the All-World Religious Conference (Parliament of Religions) in ________ in the United States of America.
solution:
The correct answer is **__"Chicago".__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Point__**

__
 
• The** 'Parliament of World's Religions'** in 1893 was a remarkable event not just for the number and variety of faiths represented for the first time, at one place.
 
• While it was known to be the event in which **Swami Vivekananda** shined, it also saw theologians from Islam, Bahai, Jainism, Buddhism, Hinduism, Brahmo Samaj and several other faiths come together and lay the foundation for an inter-faith exchange of ideas.
 
• The** World's Parliament** of persuasions started on **11 September 1893 **at the** Permanent Memorial Art Palace**( also linked as the World's Congress Auxiliary Building), **now the Art Institute of Chicago**, as part of the World's Columbian Exposition.
 
• **Vivekananda **gave his **first lecture** on that day. Though originally nervous, he bowed to Saraswati, the Hindu goddess of literacy, and he felt he got new energy in his body; he felt someone or commodity differently had enthralled his body –" The Soul of India, the echo of the Rishis, the voice of Ramakrishna, the prophet of the resurgent **Time spirit**".
 
• He also **began his speech** with salutation**," Sisters and brothers ****of America!".​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Swami Vivekananda**, born **Narendranath Datta,** was an Indian **Hindu monk**, **champion, author, religious schoolteacher, and the principal convert of the Indian Jeremiah Ramakrishna. **
 
• **Born 12 January 1863, Kolkata**
 
• **Education:** Scottish Church College( SCC), Vidyasagar College( 1871 – 1877), Presidency University, University of Calcutta
 
• **Full name: **Narendra Nath Datta
 
• **Parents: **Vishwanath Datta, Bhuvaneswari Devi
